plugins.name: Art SQL API
plugins.author: bertrandom
plugins.description: Read-only SQL over HTTP (Datasette-style JSON) for the Art app's artapp.db, on its own LAN port with an API key. Uses the TV's sqlite3. No outbound connections.

plugins.name: Bedtime
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: Turn the TV off at set times or after a sleep timer, or open an app on a schedule. No network.

plugins.name: 8BitDo Guide
plugins.author: augusto1024
plugins.description: Open the Vetro launcher with Guide on the Bluetooth 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless; forward other buttons and axes. No network access.

plugins.name: Home Assistant
plugins.author: andrearicci93
plugins.description: A Home Assistant card in Vetro's Control center for lights, switches, scenes and scripts. Talks only to the Home Assistant address you set (REST API).

plugins.name: Keyboard & Remote
plugins.author: abdoghanem2011
plugins.description: Text input, live MJPEG/1080p screen preview, and full TV remote. Connects browser to TV port 8002 (WSS); streams via 127.0.0.1.

plugins.name: NEWS
plugins.author: mclaudiopt
plugins.description: Sport (ESPN), weather (Open-Meteo), news (RSS/Google News) and civil-protection (IPMA/ANEPC) alerts on Samsung TVs via Notification Center.

plugins.name: Notification Center
plugins.author: mclaudiopt
plugins.description: Show LAN notifications as native TV banners via a companion app. Talks to Vetro on 127.0.0.1:8099 and fetches a sender's image/wallpaper URL only if sent.

plugins.name: Prometheus exporter
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: Prometheus metrics for the TV: CPU, memory, swap, network, Wi-Fi signal, SoC temperature, uptime. Reads /proc and /sys only; no network.

plugins.name: Shell
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: A root shell on the TV from the dashboard, one command at a time; cd is remembered.

plugins.name: Sonos controller
plugins.author: genesai
plugins.description: Remote volume and mute keys control Sonos via Vetro's MQTT rules, plus a Control center card for rooms. LAN only (port 1400, SSDP); reads Vetro's settings.

plugins.name: SSH server
plugins.author: bertrandom
plugins.description: A real SSH-2 server in pure JS (no binary): interactive ssh is a root line-shell, ssh root@tv 'cmd' runs as root, plus scp/sftp. Needs Node 10+.

plugins.name: TV reboot
plugins.author: genesai
plugins.description: A button that restarts the TV. Runs systemctl reboot through the TV agent (needs the exec permission).

plugins.name: TV uptime
plugins.author: andrearicci93
plugins.description: Shows how long the TV has been on. Reads /proc/uptime through the TV agent (needs the exec permission).

plugins.name: USB Ethernet
plugins.author: andrearicci93
plugins.description: Gives a USB Ethernet adapter (Realtek RTL8152/8153/8156 and branded ones) a driver and makes it the TV's wired connection after each restart. No network use.

plugins.name: VPN
plugins.author: piecifra
plugins.description: WireGuard VPN on the TV: NordVPN, or your own configs from any provider or server. Kill switch, split tunnel. Talks to api.nordvpn.com, your VPN and GitHub.

plugins.name: Ad-free YouTube
plugins.author: andrearicci93
plugins.description: Samsung's own YouTube with ads blocked, Shorts hidden and sponsors skipped (TizenTube). Local proxy; fetches one pinned script from cdn.jsdelivr.net.
